pages.title: Oxygen and Suits
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Off Earth you need **air** and the **right temperature**.
- The suit's chestplate holds the oxygen; fill it at an Oxygen Filler.
- An **Oxygen Sealer** fills a sealed room with oxygen.
- A **Temperature Regulator** sets the temperature in a box you size.
Off Earth you need air and the right temperature. Northstar handles both with sealed rooms and spacesuits. The death messages say it all: ran out of oxygen, or forgot their spacesuit.

pages.title: Iron Space Suit
pages.text: Made from iron armour, iron plates and tinted glass. The chestplate carries the oxygen supply.

pages.title: Martian Steel Space Suit
pages.text: The tougher suit. Martian steel gear and netherite diving gear are [#](7A3C9A)[tagged](entry://glossary/tags)[#]() heat resistant.

pages.title: Oxygen Filler
pages.text: Right-click in a suit, then pump Oxygen Gas in to fill it, or extract it back out.

pages.title: Oxygen Sealer
pages.text: Oxygen from behind, [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() from below, and it fills the sealed area around it. It shows how much it can seal and warns if the room leaks.

pages.title: Large Fan
pages.text: Raises the area a Sealer or Temperature Regulator can cover. Needs an [#](2E5AAC)[Encased Chain Drive](entry://create_basics/transmission)[#](); a [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() sets chain side.

pages.title: Atmospheric Concentrator
pages.text: Collects Oxygen or Carbon from air. Does nothing on worlds without an atmosphere.

pages.title: Electrolysis Machine
pages.text: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen, which fuel rockets and fill suits.

pages.title: Temperature Regulator
pages.text: Sets the temperature in a box you size. Vents let air pass; wool makes an insulated vent that blocks heat but not air.

pages.title: Solar Panel
pages.text: Turns sunlight into rotation. A Combustion Engine burns rocket fuel for rotation and needs oxidizer.
